correctness.rationale: The finite-Birkhoff downset formula I⇒J={p:I∩↓p⊆J} gives the exact Horn test for materializers. The explicit c_I preserves I∩J, so is idempotent and has fixed points exactly M_H(I). A nonempty principal cone gives union closure; two incomparable maximal points produce two individually closed J,K with nonclosed union. Universal quantification yields all principal ↓p chains, equivalent to prelinearity. The four-element poset apex above three minima gives a seven-element nondistributive internal materializer in a nine-element algebra. Independently reimplemented all naturally labelled posets n≤4 and checked local/global/forest equivalences: (n,posets,forests)=(1,1,1),(2,2,2),(3,7,6),(4,40,24). Finite checks corroborate only these orders.
